ndvi_status.source: field-median NDVI per week from Sentinel-2/Landsat/HLS (backend/field features_weekly)

phenology_note: NDVI phenology is a proxy for when green vegetation grows and dies back on this polygon. It is not a measure of game, berries or plant abundance, and for a farm field it follows the crop, not wild plants.

snow.scope: Salmon River watershed (BC FWA group SALR, 1,794 km2), not the field
snow.rule: first 8-day composite after the spring maximum with watershed snow fraction < 0.5, interpolated; composites with >60% cloud or missing pixels dropped; the series starts mid-February, so a year whose snow is already below the threshold at its first composite has no result

burn_scars.source: BC Wildfire Fire Perimeters - Historical (BC Data Catalogue)

regs_links.title: BC Hunting and Trapping Regulations Synopsis

harvest_rights_note: Aboriginal/treaty and tribal harvesting rights are set by the Nation and by law, not by this tool; provincial/state seasons shown for context only. CropLytics stores no harvest, hunting or cultural-site locations.
caveats: NDVI phenology is a proxy for when green vegetation grows and dies back on this polygon. It is not a measure of game, berries or plant abundance, and for a farm field it follows the crop, not wild plants.
